scripts.build: npm run build -w @diagramia/core && npm run build -w @diagramia/interop && npm run build -w @diagramia/providers && npm run build -w @diagramia/editor && npm run build -w @diagramia/mcp && npm run build -w @diagramia/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @diagramia/core && npm run build -w @diagramia/interop && npm run build -w @diagramia/providers && tsc --noEmit -p apps/editor/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @diagramia/core && npm run build -w @diagramia/interop && npm run build -w @diagramia/providers && npm run build -w @diagramia/mcp && node --import tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/interop/test/*.test.ts apps/mcp/test/*.test.ts apps/api/test/*.test.ts
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @diagramia/core && npm run build -w @diagramia/interop && npm run build -w @diagramia/providers
scripts.smoke:repository: npm run build -w @diagramia/api && npm run build -w @diagramia/mcp && node scripts/pg-repository-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:shared: npm run build -w @diagramia/api && npm run build -w @diagramia/mcp && node scripts/shared-browser-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:mcp-remote: npm run build -w @diagramia/mcp && npm run build -w @diagramia/api && node scripts/mcp-remote-smoke.mjs
